in_marathi.name: Jitul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit root ‘jit’ meaning ‘victory’ or ‘triumph’. The name Jitul is often given to a child born into a victorious family or as a symbol of the parent's hope for their child's future success.
